text:
Predicates:
University(x) ::: x is a university.
Private(x) ::: x is a private institution.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League institution.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to location y.
Endowment(x, y) ::: the endowment of x is valued at y.
Constituents(x, y) ::: x has constituent colleges and schools y.
College(y) ::: y is a college.
School(y) ::: y is a school.
ResidentialCollege(y) ::: y is a residential college.
ValuedAt(y, z) ::: y is valued at z.
LargestEndowment(x) ::: x has the largest endowment among educational institutions.
Premises:
YaleUniversity(yale) ∧ Private(yale) ∧ IvyLeague(yale) ∧ ResearchUniversity(yale) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
MovedTo(yale, newHaven) ∧ Year(1716) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
Endowment(yale, 42.3 billion) ::: Yale University’s endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
Constituents(yale, [BenjaminFranklin, Berkeley, Branford, Davenport, EzraStiles, GraceHopper, JonathanEdwards, Morse, PauliMurray, Pierson, Saybrook, Silliman, TimothyDwight, Trumbull]) ::: Yale University has these constituent colleges and schools.
LargestEndowment(yale) ::: Yale University has the largest endowment of any educational institution.
Conclusion:
∃x (Endowment(x, y) ∧ y > 42.3 billion) ::: There exists an institution with an endowment larger than Yale.
